name: 以前の保存先と復元・完全削除を持つ削除ページの行
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese Trash result row using the supplied references. The corrected original crop is primary for row geometry, the page icon, and restore/delete control placement; the Japanese mock is primary for exact text. Output only one compact horizontal row at approximately 416×48 proportions (about 8.67:1), with no surrounding panel or broad empty bands.

At the far left, show a small outlined page/document icon. Next to it, stack the bold page title 「制作の進め方 (2)」 and the smaller muted previous-location line 「制作の方針」. Align two compact actions at the far right: a simple curved restore arrow and an outlined trash-can delete control. Use consistent vertical alignment, a restrained white/gray palette, subtle icon strokes, and crisp Japanese sans-serif text. Do not add any page content, descriptions, counts, or actions beyond those shown.
reviewNotes: Registered v001 with stored:true and catalogUpdated:true. Candidate reproduces page title, previous location, restore, and delete controls, but its 2092x752 (2.782:1) canvas is far taller than the corrected 508x60 crop (8.467:1) and 416x48 mock (8.667:1), leaving broad blank bands; needs-correction. The supplied crop x=312,y=513 missed the row; corrected crop x=303,y=700,w=508,h=60 is documented. SHA-256 matches manifest/catalog; prompt/references and HTML entry verified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
